a: Mocks replace real dependencies to isolate the unit under test.
Stubs return fixed data for calls during a test.
Fixtures set up reusable test data or environment.
Coverage measures which lines ran; high coverage is not full proof.
Regression tests catch bugs that return after fixes.
Smoke tests check basic critical paths quickly.
Load tests measure behavior under expected concurrent traffic.
Stress tests push beyond normal limits to find breaking points.
Contract tests verify two services agree on request/response shapes.
Always review snapshot updates; do not accept blindly.
